description: A quantifier-free formula has the same truth value in an induced substructure and its ambient structure at every assignment from the substructure.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.qf_restriction.{u_1} (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ)
  {M : Type u_1} [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).Structure M]
  (D : Finset M)
  (hc :
    ∀ (i : Fin c),
      FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.ConstantSymbol.constant i) Fin.elim0 ∈
        D)
  {n : ℕ} (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).BoundedFormula Empty n)
  (hq : φ.IsQF) (v : Fin n → ↥(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.induced c arities D hc)) :
  (φ.Realize Empty.elim fun i => ↑(v i)) ↔ φ.Realize Empty.elim v
